Class Game

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am49.server.model.Game
public class Game extends Object
Represents a game session involving players, a game board, and various gameplay functionalities. This class manages the core logic for initializing, managing players, tracking game progress, and handling various aspects of the game flow.

  • Constructor Details

    • Game

      public Game(Player admin, GameSession session, GameMode mode, int maxPlayers, int seedForGeneration)
      Creates a new game instance with the specified admin player, session, game mode, maximum number of players, and a seed for board generation.
      Parameters:
      admin - The Player who is the administrator of the game.
      session - The GameSession associated with this game.
      mode - The GameMode to be used for the game setup.
      maxPlayers - The maximum number of players allowed in the game, adjusted to a minimum of 2 and a maximum of 4.
      seedForGeneration - The seed for random generation processes in the game, such as board setup.
